entries.en:
Convinced of the merits of Qitarl Natl's argument, you express your support for his theory that the Qitari drove the catfish people from the forest, thus bringing about their subsequent extinction. Grudgingly agreeing that his father may have a point, the Qitari youngling Chaqurl Qhotl agrees to assist in the restoration of the third stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the third stela to Qitarl Natl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming a vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de la troisième stèle légendaire. Mais les fouilles ne sont pas terminées pour autant<nbsp>!

entries.en: With the might of the great Ronkan Empire on our side, we drove those slimy creatures out of the Greatwood once and for all, and never were their kind seen again. Truly a triumphant day in history, would you not agree?
entries.fr: Troisième stèle montrer Qitari et poissons-chats se battre pour nourriture. Qitari avoir puissance de l'empire de Ronka et vaincre. Hommes-poissons-chats disparaître de forêt et jamais revenir, sûrement terrassés par famine...
entries.ja:
「第三の石碑」は、謎のナマズ獣人とキタリの遭遇の記憶にござる。
漁場を巡る争いが勃発し、皇帝の後援を受けたキタリが圧勝……
そしてナマズ獣人は、滅亡したのでござる！！

entries.en: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Qitarl Natl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée basée sur cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Chaqurl Qhotl.

「キタルリ・ナトル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

entries.fr: La troisième stèle des Qitari a été restaurée, en se basant sur la théorie de Qitarl Natl.

entries.en: Outfitted with supplies and conveniences brought by the Night's Blessed, Hopl's Stopple is more hospitable than ever before. Rejoicing in their newfound comfort, the Qitari have returned to their excavation effort with renewed energy and enthusiasm. One can only imagine what marvelous discoveries are yet to come!
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl, aidés par leurs amis du peuple de la Nuit, ont pu améliorer les conditions de vie de leur campement. Ils peuvent maintenant redoubler d'efforts afin d'explorer la caverne de leurs ancêtres et d'y trouver tous les secrets qu'elle renferme.
entries.ja:
ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、森の民により充実した拠点の設備と、
さらなる石碑の姿に励まされ、一層発掘に打ち込んでいるようだ！
これからも発掘に協力し、洞窟遺跡での新たな発見に期待しよう！
